gueguen.title: Does red lipstick really attract men? An evaluation in a bar

tian.title: Red vs orange-red vs cameo red lipstick, rated by men

vo.hook: Same woman, four lipsticks. Which one gets approached first in a bar?
vo.answer: If you picked red, a real field study backs you up.
vo.method: Researchers sent women into bars on the French Atlantic coast wearing red, pink, brown, or no lipstick, then counted how many men came over, and how fast.
vo.result: Red won on both. More men approached her, and the first one showed up sooner.
vo.reds: But the exact red matters. In a twenty twenty-three study, men rated true red as more attractive than orange-red or cameo red.
vo.pivot: Then again, nobody picks a lipstick to impress strangers in a bar. Wear the shade that makes you feel like you.
vo.cta: So which shade are you wearing tonight? Tell me in the comments.

captions.reds: But the exact red matters. In a 2023 study, men rated true red as more attractive than orange-red or cameo red.
